title: devices.json sessions
description: The login sessions of the person: times, login method, client component and last IP. No cookie hash, no refresh token, no step-up state.

device_id.description: ID of the device of the session.

client_component.description: Client component that holds the session.

auth_method.description: Login method that started the session.

expires_at.description: When the session expires at the latest.

last_seen_at.description: Last use of the session; absent when never recorded.

last_ip.description: Last IP address of the session; absent when none was recorded.

revoked_at.description: When the session ended; absent while it is live.

revoke_reason.description: Why the session ended; absent while it is live.
